children: Planet Green Holdings entered into an at-the-market (ATM) Sales Agreement with Craft Capital to offer and sell common stock from time to time. Based on its current public float and Form S-3 limits, the company estimates it can sell up to approximately $22.54 million over a 12-month period. Sales may be made on NYSE American or otherwise, with a 4.0% commission to the agent, and can be suspended or terminated at any time. The program is intended to provide flexible access to equity capital under the company's effective shelf registration.
: Provide flexible access to capital via at-the-market equity issuance
